title: 卑尔维斯·丝带花园
description: 紫色蝠鲼形卑尔维斯温和收拢翼鳍，照看一株小盆花，保留独特冠状头部与长尾。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Bel'Veth is a vast manta-like Void empress with sweeping purple wing-fins, a long tapering tail, pale gold accents, and a small crowned humanoid-looking head above the broad ray body. Preserve the unusual ray silhouette and graceful fin edges without exposing a frightening maw or rows of teeth. Her expression and flowing shapes should be calm, rounded, and unmistakably fantastical.
art_direction.scene: She folds her broad fins loosely around a small garden patch while using one fin tip to steady a flowerpot wearing a simple ribbon. A second little pot and a curved stone bench provide scale. Keep her full silhouette inside the square, with a bright paper background and a curious caring tilt of the head.
art_direction.palette: lavender, plum purple, muted gold, peach flower
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
